page.overview:
What is Mahakam Volunteer Army?

The Mahakam Volunteer Army was a dwarven infantry unit. They were sent by Brouver Hoog to fight on the side of the Northern Kingdoms against the Nilfgaardian Empire. Due to them being non-humans, they were often sent on the most dangerous missions and to the most dangerous sectors, places that human commanders did not want to send humans to. They were armed with halberds, guisarmes, battle-axes, flails, and morning stars.

After having previously sent volunteers with Queen Meve's partisan army after a Scoia'tael attack in Mahakam, under strict orders that they were not to fraternise with humans and were to be sent back to the mountain realm after the war's end, he sent an army to aid the Northern monarchs when they launched their counteroffensives. The dwarves fought in Temeria down to the Yaruga.

After the Battle of Mayena, the regiment was recalled to Vizima to regroup and rest, as they had suffered heavy casualties. In Vizima, the positions that had become vacant due to deaths were filled, and many new volunteers joined after hearing news of the battle.

Having regrouped and rested, the dwarves then took part in the decisive Battle of Brenna. During the battle, they were positioned on the right flank and were 1000 dwarves strong. Following the victory at Brenna, they later also fought at Maribor and near the Yaruga.
